int_name: N BROAD ST & W ERIE AVE

result.summary: The image depicts a high-activity urban intersection adjacent to a transit entrance with basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks and signals. However, the environment is dominated by vehicle traffic and lacks physical buffers or traffic calming measures to protect pedestrians in this commercial zone.

hazards.name: Pedestrian Crowding and Obstructions
hazards.description: Street activity and vendors near the subway entrance narrow the effective walking width of the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Corner Protection
hazards.description: The wide turning radius and lack of physical barriers at the corner expose pedestrians to turning vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Visual Distraction
hazards.description: Large-scale commercial billboards and dense signage may distract drivers from observing pedestrians at the crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, reducing conflicts with turning traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Install street trees to provide a vertical buffer between the roadway and the sidewalk, while also improving the pedestrian environment.

result.summary: The image depicts a large, multi-lane urban intersection with significant pedestrian exposure due to long crossing distances. While basic infrastructure like marked crosswalks and signals are present, the environment lacks physical protection such as refuge islands or curb extensions.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corner may obscure pedestrians from the view of turning drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with significant vehicle traffic but a complete lack of visible pedestrian crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or signals. While sidewalks are present, the environment prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety and connectivity.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.
